destariamasteries:alchemy-mastery-desc: Turn nature's ingredients into deadly weapons and potent buffs. The Alchemy mastery unlocks the ability to brew powerful potions, coat weapons in lingering toxins, and unleash devastating explosive and chemical attacks.
destariamasteries:alchemy-basicconcoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft minor potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalnourishm: Consuming mushrooms provides {0} additional saturation and increases your healing effectiveness by {1}%% for 10 seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxictransmuta: Reduces the harmful effects of consuming mushrooms by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalfingers-: Unlocks the ability to craft mushroom substrate.
destariamasteries:alchemy-virulentreacti: Increases the damage potency of your poisons by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-potentdecoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft highly potent potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-dazzleblast-de: Blinds a targeted enemy for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-poisoncloud-de:
Creates a lingering cloud of poison for {0} seconds.
Requires a mushroom. The cloud's poison damage is dependent on the type of mushroom used.
destariamasteries:alchemy-concussiveblas: Deafens a targeted enemy for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-primedtoxin-de: Coats your equipped blade in poison, causing your attacks to poison targets for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-granddetonatio: Unlocks the ability to craft powerful explosives.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxicreserves-: While poisoned, your movement speed is increased by {0}%% and hunger depletion is reduced by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-costlymistake-: Inflicts poison upon yourself for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-catalyticsurge: Purges all poison effects from yourself, healing you for {0}%% of the damage the poison would have dealt.
destariamasteries:healing-mastery-desc: Endure injury, recover faster, and turn simple medical supplies into reliable lifesavers.
destariamasteries:healing-thickskinned-d: Increases healing effectiveness and healing item use speed by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:healing-soulrecovery-d: Instantly restores {0}%% of your missing health. Cooldown: {1} minutes.
destariamasteries:healing-soultouch-desc: Soul Recovery also heals nearby players for {0}%% of the health restored to you.
destariamasteries:healing-herbalremedies: Unlocks the ability to craft the temporal bandage (a bandage that also heals nearby players).
destariamasteries:healing-shockingfinger: Instantly revives a targeted player without consuming a bandage. Cooldown: {0} minutes.
